text:
The Studienstiftung des deutschen Volkes was initially founded in Dresden in 1925 but was dissolved under National Socialism in 1934. It was newly formed as a registered association in Cologne in 1948. The Studienstiftung offers a general scholarship for bachelor's and master's studies, providing both financial and academic support, contingent upon eligibility criteria similar to BAFöG. This scholarship accepts full-time students studying in Germany, another EU country, or Switzerland, without requiring German or EU citizenship or having an age limit.
Admission to the Studienstiftung is managed through several channels, including nomination by schools, nominations by professors, and nominations from examination boards. Students can also apply through an Assessment Test since February 2010. The organization selects exceptionally talented students based on the principles of "excellence, initiative and responsibility." Furthermore, the Studienstiftung provides a doctoral scholarship for highly qualified and prosocial PhD students.
